d: Large atrium of feudal palace. It leads to the left that puts to the oratory, another door to the right that leads to the noble apartments. From the terrace in the bottom you can see the Elba. At the rise of the canvas the scene is cluttered by Women intent on the work of the archer.
Ulm who must have appeared on the right door while Oberto and Edmea were moving away.

The courtyard of a tavern. To the left the door that puts in the interior. In the middle wide door open on the street. Under a canopy, wooden tables and seats. To the side of the large door a stone bench. Fritz followed by Giullari and Saltimbanchi. The Host. Craftsman.
A illuminated park. - At the bottom of the scene a lake. - On the right side of the palace with large staircase. - Flowers, statues, etc., etc.
Oberto, the Count, the Baron, Lords, Dames, then Fritz, Saltimbanchi, Giullari, etc., Edmea and Ulmo.

To the right, a castle. - To the left, in the rustic cottage background. - On the front of the scene a group of fir trees. - To the left, avenue of cypresses, in whose background you can see a funeral monument. Women, who come from different avenues.
Edmea, who advances slowly, hesitantly and surprise.
Ulmo appears at the bottom of the scene as pale as a spectre.
